# multinomialTS

This is the initial working version of `multinomialTS`. See [the
vignettes on the package
website](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/index.html) on how
to use the model.

## Installation

### Windows

The best way to install at the moment is to compile from source:

- If you have Rtools44 or (Rtools45 for R 4.5) and devtools installed,
  you can build the latest version of the package directly from github
  using:
  `devtools::install_github("https://github.com/QuinnAsena/multinomialTS")`

Alternatively, if you are having issues with the build tools, install
the binaries:

- `install.packages("https://github.com/QuinnAsena/multinomialTS/releases/download/v1.0.2/multinomialTS_1.0.2-windows.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")`

### macOS

The best way to install at the moment is to compile from source:

- If you have xcode-select and devtools installed, you can build the
  latest version of the package directly from github using:
  `devtools::install_github("https://github.com/QuinnAsena/multinomialTS")`

- On apple it is nice and easy to download xcode-select by opening a
  terminal and copying this code: `xcode-select --install`. Then try and
  run:
  `devtools::install_github("https://github.com/QuinnAsena/multinomialTS")`

Alternatively, if you are having issues with the build tools, install
the binaries:

For new M-series macs, use:

- `install.packages("https://github.com/QuinnAsena/multinomialTS/releases/download/v1.0.2/multinomialTS_1.0.2-macOS-arm64.tgz", repos = NULL)`

For Intel macs, use:

- `install.packages("https://github.com/QuinnAsena/multinomialTS/releases/download/v1.0.2/multinomialTS_1.0.2-macOS-x86_64.tgz", repos = NULL)`

# Package index

## All functions

- [`boot()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/boot.md)
  : Multinomial state-space bootstrap
- [`boot(`*`<mnTS>`*`)`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/boot.mnTS.md)
  : Bootstrap method for mnTS objects
- [`bootstrap_sensitivity`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/bootstrap_sensitivity.md)
  : Sunfish Pond bootstrapped sensitivity
- [`coef(`*`<mnTS>`*`)`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/coef.mnTS.md)
  : Coefficients for Multinomial State-Space Model
- [`mnGLMM()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/mnGLMM.md)
  : Multinomial Generalized Linear Mixed Model (mnGLMM)
- [`mnGLMM.ml()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/mnGLMM.ml.md)
  : Multinomial GLMM Maximum likelihood
- [`mnTS()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/mnTS.md)
  : Multinomial State-Space Model (mnTS)
- [`mnTS.ml()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/mnTS.ml.md)
  : Multinomial state-space Maximum likelihood
- [`mnTS.ml.wrapper()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/mnTS.ml.wrapper.md)
  : mnTS Wrapper
- [`mnTS_ml_cpp_listout()`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/mnTS_ml_cpp_listout.md)
  : mnTS_ml_cpp_list
- [`simulate(`*`<mnTS>`*`)`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/simulate.mnTS.md)
  : Simulate Data from a Multinomial State-Space Model
- [`story_100_bootstraps`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/story_100_bootstraps.md)
  : Story 100 bootstraps
- [`story_char_matrix`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/story_char_matrix.md)
  : Story Charcoal Matrix
- [`story_char_wide`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/story_char_wide.md)
  : Story Charcoal Wide
- [`story_pollen_matrix`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/story_pollen_matrix.md)
  : Story Pollen Matrix
- [`story_pollen_wide`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/story_pollen_wide.md)
  : Story Pollen Wide
- [`summary(`*`<mnGLMM>`*`)`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/summary.mnGLMM.md)
  : GLMM summary
- [`summary(`*`<mnTS>`*`)`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/summary.mnTS.md)
  : Summary Method for Multinomial State-Space Models
- [`sunfish_ll`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/sunfish_ll.md)
  : Sunfish Pond level
- [`sunfish_pollen_wide`](https://quinnasena.github.io/multinomialTS/reference/sunfish_pollen_wide.md)
  : Sunfish Pond pollen
